sourceRefs.locator: Catalogue headings Kitabe and Onarım Durumu on the location of the inscriptions, fire and the trustee Sirâcüddin Ahmed. Note 5 compares Konyalı’s AH 667 with Aslanapa’s and Dursun’s AH 677. Notes 2–3 identify the work on the builder’s medallion and repair inscription.

Vol. 37, pp. 503–504. Portals and dated AH 626 inscription, raised courtyard masjid, raised platforms, lighting, water channels and conduit from Bağluca. Gives the earlier reading AH 667 for the repair.
Section Sultanhan, entrance inscriptions and courtyard. Embedded site map centred at 38.248279° N, 33.546923° E for orientation at the han.

labels.de: Ein zweites Datum am Sultan Han
labels.en: A second date at the Sultan Han

note.de: Eine Zeile unter dem Türsturz erinnert an den Verwalter, der das beschädigte Tor instand setzen ließ. Die jüngere Lesung der Jahreszahl ergibt 1278/79.
note.en: A line below the lintel records the administrator who had the damaged gate repaired. The more recent reading of its date gives 1278/79.
